targets.rawSql:
-- A poller is no longer 1:1 with a watch (see availability_watch_poller);
-- this aggregates the watch ids currently attached to each poller.
-- availability_poller has only a boolean `active` flag (no paused/done states),
-- so the legacy 3-way ${status} filter collapses to active/not-active here.
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.provider,
  p.parent_ref,
  p.poi_id,
  array_remove(array_agg(DISTINCT wp.watch_id), NULL) AS watch_ids,
  p.active,
  p.next_run_at,
  p.claimed_until,
  p.last_run_at,
  p.created_at,
  p.updated_at
FROM availability_poller p
LEFT JOIN availability_watch_poller wp ON wp.poller_id = p.id
WHERE (${status:sqlstring} = '' OR p.active = (${status:sqlstring} = 'active'))
  AND (${watch_id:sqlstring} = '' OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM availability_watch_poller wp2
    WHERE wp2.poller_id = p.id AND wp2.watch_id = NULLIF(${watch_id:sqlstring}, '')::bigint
  ))
GROUP BY p.id
ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC
LIMIT 100;

-- availability_poller has no paused/done states (see /api/availability/pollers panel);
-- summary is active vs inactive instead of the old 3-way status breakdown.
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE active) AS active,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT active) AS inactive,
  count(*) FILTER (
    WHERE active
      AND next_run_at <= now()
      AND (claimed_until IS NULL OR claimed_until < now())
  ) AS due_now,
  count(*) FILTER (
    WHERE claimed_until IS NOT NULL
      AND claimed_until >= now()
  ) AS claimed
FROM availability_poller;

SELECT
  id,
  poller_id,
  status,
  snapshot_count,
  duration_ms,
  error,
  started_at,
  completed_at
FROM availability_run
WHERE ${poller_id:sqlstring} <> ''
  AND poller_id = NULLIF(${poller_id:sqlstring}, '')::bigint
ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  id,
  poller_id,
  status,
  snapshot_count,
  duration_ms,
  error,
  started_at,
  completed_at
FROM availability_run
WHERE (${run_status:sqlstring} = '' OR status = ${run_status:sqlstring})
  AND (${poller_id:sqlstring} = '' OR poller_id = NULLIF(${poller_id:sqlstring}, '')::bigint)
  AND (${since:sqlstring} = '' OR started_at >= NULLIF(${since:sqlstring}, '')::timestamptz)
ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS reservable_id,
  s.run_id,
  s.target_date,
  lag(s.last_observed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.reservable_id, s.target_date ORDER BY s.last_observed_at, s.id) AS observed_from,
  s.last_observed_at AS observed_at,
  s.status,
  (s.status = 'available') AS available
FROM availability s
JOIN reservables r ON r.id = s.reservable_id
WHERE ${reservable_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND r.id::text = ${reservable_id:sqlstring}
ORDER BY s.target_date DESC, s.last_observed_at DESC, s.id DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
  r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS reservable_id,
  s.run_id,
  s.target_date,
  lag(s.last_observed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY s.reservable_id, s.target_date ORDER BY s.last_observed_at, s.id) AS observed_from,
  s.last_observed_at AS observed_at,
  s.status,
  (s.status = 'available') AS available
FROM availability s
LEFT JOIN reservables r ON r.id = s.reservable_id
WHERE ${run_id:sqlstring} <> ''
  AND s.run_id = NULLIF(${run_id:sqlstring}, '')::bigint
ORDER BY s.target_date ASC
LIMIT 500;

WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT
    s.id,
    s.target_date,
    s.last_observed_at,
    s.status,
    lag(s.last_observed_at) OVER (
      PARTITION BY s.target_date
      ORDER BY s.last_observed_at, s.id
    ) AS observed_from
  FROM availability s
  JOIN reservables r ON r.id = s.reservable_id
  WHERE ${reservable_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND r.id::text = ${reservable_id:sqlstring}
    AND s.last_observed_at >= now() - (${window_hours:sqlstring} || ' hours')::interval
)
SELECT
  target_date,
  count(*) AS total_runs,
  max(last_observed_at) FILTER (WHERE status = 'available') AS last_open_at,
  (array_agg((status = 'available') ORDER BY last_observed_at DESC, id DESC))[1] AS is_currently_open,
  (array_agg(extract(epoch from (last_observed_at - coalesce(observed_from, last_observed_at))) ORDER BY last_observed_at DESC, id DESC) FILTER (WHERE status = 'available'))[1] AS current_or_last_open_window_sec,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch from (last_observed_at - coalesce(observed_from, last_observed_at)))) FILTER (WHERE status = 'available') AS median_open_window_sec,
  count(*) FILTER (
    WHERE status = 'available'
      AND coalesce(observed_from, last_observed_at) >= now() - interval '24 hours'
  ) AS opens_last_24h
FROM scoped
GROUP BY target_date
ORDER BY target_date ASC;

SELECT
  r.id,
  r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS provider_key,
  r.type,
  r.vendor,
  r.vendor_id,
  r.name,
  r.loop,
  r.site_type,
  array_remove(array_agg(p.id ORDER BY p.id), NULL) AS poi_ids,
  r.tags,
  r.raw
FROM reservables r
LEFT JOIN reservable_pois rp ON rp.reservable_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = rp.poi_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND (${vendor:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.vendor = ${vendor:sqlstring})
  AND (${site_type:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR r.site_type = ${site_type:sqlstring})
  AND (${name:sqlstring} = '' OR r.name = ${name:sqlstring})
GROUP BY r.id
ORDER BY r.type ASC, r.vendor ASC, r.vendor_id ASC
LIMIT 100;

SELECT
  r.id,
  r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS provider_key,
  r.type,
  r.vendor,
  r.vendor_id,
  r.name,
  r.loop,
  r.site_type,
  array_remove(array_agg(p.id ORDER BY p.id), NULL) AS poi_ids,
  r.provider_ref,
  r.tags,
  r.raw
FROM reservables r
LEFT JOIN reservable_pois rp ON rp.reservable_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN pois p ON p.id = rp.poi_id AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND r.id::text = ${reservable_id:sqlstring}
GROUP BY r.id;

SELECT
  id,
  name,
  category,
  region,
  ST_X(ST_Centroid(geom)) AS lng,
  ST_Y(ST_Centroid(geom)) AS lat
FROM pois
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
  AND ${poi_query:sqlstring} <> ''
  AND name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_query:sqlstring} || '%'
ORDER BY
  (name ILIKE ${poi_query:sqlstring} || '%') DESC,
  length(name) ASC,
  name ASC
LIMIT 25;

list.name: reservable_id
list.query: SELECT id::text || ' - ' || coalesce(name, 'unnamed') || ' [' || type || ':' || vendor || ':' || vendor_id || ']' AS __text, id::text AS __value FROM reservables WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY type ASC, vendor ASC, vendor_id ASC LIMIT 1000

list.name: vendor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vendor AS __text, vendor AS __value FROM reservables WHERE vendor IS NOT NULL ORDER BY vendor ASC

list.name: site_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT site_type AS __text, site_type AS __value FROM reservables WHERE site_type IS NOT NULL ORDER BY site_type ASC
